strategies.no_regime_optimizer: CVXPY optimizer with the Bull constraint set always (HMM removed)
strategies.vol_rule: 63-day realised equity volatility thresholds -> fixed regime weights (no HMM)
strategies.hmm_fixed: HMM regime -> fixed regime weights (no optimizer)
strategies.min_variance: Long-only minimum variance, 252-day sample covariance, w <= 0.80
strategies.static_6040: Static 60% equity / 40% bond, rebalanced on RegimeShift fill dates
strategies.equal_weight: Static 1/3 each, rebalanced on RegimeShift fill dates

evaluation_types.full_sample: One continuous online backtest over the common evaluation index.
evaluation_types.chronological_attribution: A calendar slice of the SAME continuous online backtest. Holdings at the slice start were formed before it. It attributes performance to periods; it is not an independent re-fit or a walk-forward model-selection test.
evaluation_types.walk_forward_selection: Each evaluation window uses a strategy chosen only from information that ended before the window started; the selection rule is fixed in advance.

attempts.A_sharpe_rf0: max trailing 3y rf=0 net Sharpe (run first, kept)
attempts.B_sharpe_vs_cash: max trailing 3y Sharpe of net minus cash proxy

cash_proxy: bond (LIQUIDBEES adj. close); distributions recorded only 2013-01-01..2025-09-30
